subject: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we can size Dedicated properly: 

What I heard you say today:
- You're leaning toward Dedicated capacity (data isolation + predictable throughput) vs Hosted API.
- Primary workload is customer-facing chat (multi-turn) with occasional single-turn summarization routes.
- Desire for predictable latency (p95 under ~300ms for chat completions) and burst capacity during marketing demos.

To build a concrete sizing estimate we need a few items from your side (attached a template):
1) Peak TPS / requests-per-second targets (and expected burst behavior).
2) Typical and max token mix per request (prompt vs completion, avg tokens).
3) Concurrency expectations (concurrent users & per-user concurrency).
4) Preferred models or model sizes (13B vs 70B, quantized vs fp16).
5) Any region, compliance (VPC/KMS), or SLA requirements.

Rafael (cc) is our Solutions Engineer and will take the sizing workbook once Jordan fills it. I also cc'ed Aditya since he owns cost/quantization recommendations if you plan to run larger models.

Attached: dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

If you can send a filled sample of the template and a 24-72h traffic sample (CSV) we'll turn around an initial sizing + cost estimate within 2 business days. Happy to schedule a 30m follow-up tomorrow or Thursday — what works for you?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@fintechco.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the template. Aisha (cc) and I discussed and we filled out the high-level numbers below; we will attach a 48-hour traffic sample by EOD.

High-level answers:
- Deployment mode: Dedicated (we want data isolation and predictable throughput).
- Peak TPS: 120 req/s steady for primary chat route, with burst peaks up to ~350 req/s during demos (10-15 min windows).
- Avg tokens per request: ~300 tokens (prompt ~200, completion ~100).
- Max tokens we send: often capped at 1,024 but typical is 512 for safety.
- Concurrency: ~1,200 concurrent end-users during peak, but per-request concurrency (hot paths) ~8-12.
- Models: Start with a 13B open model (we're evaluating larger 70B for high-R
t fidelity routes). Ideally we'd like the option to run both and route based on cost/latency.
- Region: US-West primarily.
- Compliance: SOC2 is required; we also need KMS integration for keys.

Attaching: fintechco-prod-traffic-sample.csv (48h export)

Next steps: please put together a sizing that shows 2 configurations (13B baseline, 70B optional) and include cost/sla trade-offs. Also call out latency p50/p95 expectations per config. We could do a 30m call with Rafael to walk the workbook — Thurs 10-11am PT works for our team.

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Head of ML Platforms, FinTechCo
jordan.lee@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up

Perfect — thanks for the numbers and the CSV, Jordan. Rafael and Aditya will use those to produce a sizing. A few quick clarifying Qs so we size GPUs and concurrency appropriately: 

1) Chat profile: what percentage of traffic is multi-turn chat vs single-turn summarization? (rough %)
2) Tokenization: are you using a 1-token-per-0.75-char estimate or do you have exact token counts in the CSV?
3) SLA tolerance: is p95 latency >500ms acceptable for the 70B routes if that lowers cost significantly, or do you need consistent p95 <300ms across all routes?
4) Encryption / KMS: do you require HSM-backed keys or standard cloud KMS?

Preliminary guidance (for planning):
- 13B models: A100s (80GB) often hit good cost/latency balance; a pool of 4-8 A100s typically supports 100-200 TPS depending on batching and seq length.
- 70B models: H100s or A100-80GB with multi-GPU sharding; expect higher RAM and NVLink needs. For 70B at p95 <300ms under conversational loads we often recommend starting with 4 H100s and tuning batching + KV cache.

Rafael: can you take the attached CSV and produce two sizing options (13B baseline, 70B optional) with expected p50/p95, recommended GPU type/count, and rough monthly cost ranges? Jordan — Thurs 10am PT for a 30m walkthrough works; I'll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@fintechco.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up

Thanks — answers below and attaching the CSV export you requested (already uploaded):

1) Chat profile: ~70% multi-turn chat, 30% single-turn summarization.
2) Tokenization: CSV includes exact token counts per request (we added token_count column).
3) SLA tolerance: for customer-facing chat we need p95 <300ms for 13B routes. For 70B routes we can accept p95 up to ~500ms during initial rollout, as long as its documented and monitored.
4) KMS: cloud KMS is fine for now; HSM is a future ask (we'll flag once we enter enterprise procurement).

Attached: fintechco-prod-traffic-sample.csv (uploaded to your Drive link)

One more ask: can Rafael include a short recommendation on batching knobs and KV cache parameters for the chat workload? That will help our infra plan. Looking forward to the Thurs walkthrough.

Best,
Jordan
